description: We are the Stellar Explorer team from  Space Lab, Krishna Vikash Residential School. We are interested in astronomy, space science, robotics, and technology. We enjoy exploring new ideas, solving problems, and learning new things.We are excited to connect with students who share our passion for science and space exploration. We welcome members who are interested in coding, research, designing, data analysis, or coming up with innovative ideas. Together, we hope to learn, collaborate, and create
summary: We are the students of Krishna Vikash Residential School, Bargarh, Odisha. Driven by curiosity, creativity, and a passion for space exploration. Our team has come together to participate in this challenge . Through our project, we are going to showcase our innovative minds and creativity. We chose our topic “ Abundant But Not Forgotten“ because - - It makes us realise that how human curiosity and intelligence can make impossible things to be possible- Its story inspires us that we should work even when there are difficulties in our life- It represents years of hard work and teamwork We have choose this rover because - - It broke many records, far exceeding its originally planned mission duration.- It inspired many people that they could even survive after facing lots of trouble .- It was one of the NASA’ s most successful rovers , making remarkable discoveries about Red Planet MARS .The main aim of this project is to make learning about opportunity rover simple, fun and exciting. Through this creative conversation, we introduced our beloved ~ Opportunity, its journey, explorations and discoveries!
details: Through this project, we aim to inspire young minds to discover the remarkable journey of the Opportunity rover, encouraging curiosity, creativity, and a deeper interest in space exploration.
dataRefs: Spirit & Opportunity: Twin rovers that operated for years. Both are now inactive monuments to Mars exploration.
